prompt: Build a signal-based authentication state manager that persists login status to localStorage and syncs across tabs.
criterion: Auth state managed via signals, persists to localStorage, and updates across tabs via storage event without RxJS.

prompt: Create a server-rendered component that conditionally renders content based on a signal derived from request headers.
criterion: Server renders correct content based on signal initialized from request headers, and hydration preserves state without flicker.

prompt: Create a signal-driven real-time clock component that updates every second without setInterval in NgZone.
criterion: Clock updates every second via requestAnimationFrame outside NgZone, SSR renders placeholder, and hydration resumes correctly.

prompt: Implement a signal-based drag-and-drop system that tracks item positions without using DOM events in NgZone.
criterion: Drag positions tracked via signals, events handled outside NgZone, and UI updates reactively without zone-induced re-renders.

prompt: Develop a server-rendered product list that filters reactively via signal-driven search, with hydration preserving scroll position.
criterion: Search filters update UI via signals, SSR renders initial list, and hydration restores exact scroll position without jitter.

prompt: Design a signal-based multi-language translator that switches locale on user selection and re-renders SSR content accordingly.
criterion: Locale changes trigger full UI re-render via signals, SSR outputs correct locale content, and hydration matches server HTML.

prompt: Build a standalone component that uses signals to manage a theme toggle and propagates changes to all child components without inputs.
criterion: Theme changes propagate instantly to all descendants via signals, no @Input() used, and SSR respects initial theme.

prompt: Build a standalone component that renders dynamic markdown content with signal-driven syntax highlighting and SSR support.
criterion: Markdown renders server-side, highlighting updates reactively via signals, and hydration preserves rendered structure.

prompt: Create a standalone Angular component that uses signals to manage a counter, updates UI reactively without NgZone, and renders server-side with hydration.
criterion: Component updates UI reactively via signals without NgZone, renders correctly on server, and hydrates without hydration mismatch errors.

prompt: Build a standalone component that renders a live collaborative document with signal-based cursor positions from server-sent events.
criterion: Cursor positions update reactively via signals from SSE, SSR renders placeholder, and hydration syncs with server state.
